caption: The drawing features a lidded glass goblet depicted in pencil on a light beige background. The goblet has a rounded base supporting a baluster stem, and the bowl of the goblet is cylindrical, widening slightly at the top. The lid fits securely and has a finial knob at the top. Both the bowl and the lid are decorated with etched patterns: the bowl features criss-cross diamond shapes with fan or leaf-like motifs radiating upward within each diamond, while the lid exhibits a similar pattern. The glass is shown with careful shading to suggest its transparency and reflective surface. The name "John Dana" is written in small letters in the lower right corner of the drawing. A small scale indicator appears in the lower left corner. The overall composition is centered and symmetrical on the page.
title: Sugar Bowl with Cover
